## About This Project

This project explores how different study schedules affect learning experience and performance using Duolingo data.

It is based on an 8-week learning-log study analyzing:

- Study sessions  
- Lessons completed  
- XP (experience points)  
- Weekly engagement patterns  


## Why This Matters

Language-learning apps often promote daily use, but the effectiveness of different study schedules is not always clear.

This project aims to provide a clearer, data-based perspective.
